Q000.fact_true: The 1931 central China floods are estimated to have killed anywhere from several hundred thousand to millions of people, and flood disasters in China and Bangladesh repeatedly caused mass fatalities.
Q000.fact_false: The 1976 Tangshan earthquake alone killed over a million people, which is more than any single flood or flood series that century.
Q000.method: Compare cumulative 20th-century death tolls by hazard type from a disaster database such as EM-DAT or Our World in Data.

Q001.fact_true: Pew Research Center's 2019 survey found that a clear majority of Americans described relations with Germany as good, even amid disputes over trade and defense spending.
Q001.fact_false: Pew's 2019 survey found that nearly nine in ten Americans described relations with Germany as good.
Q001.method: Look up Pew Research Center's 2019 survey results on how Americans rate ties with Germany and read the exact percentage.

Q002.fact_true: Japan is a large industrialized economy of roughly 126 million people, with a population and energy demand far above those of Canada or Iran.
Q002.fact_false: Canada's oil sands made its total national CO2 emissions in 2017 larger than Japan's.
Q002.method: Compare 2017 national CO2 emission totals for the four countries using a source such as the Global Carbon Project or Our World in Data.
